entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""A coalition government with the NF..."
entries.dialogueText: "A coalition government with the NFP can mean a lot of things. But one thing is for sure, Mr. Kibener is a dangerous man. He'll use all the power we give him."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We should be careful, sir.""
